description: Send a price/quote request to Barmaan's sales team (same inbox as the website form). Ask the user for name and phone first; never invent contact details. Call once with confirm=false to get a preview, show it to the user, then call with confirm=true only after they agree.

confirm.description: false = preview only, nothing is sent. Set true ONLY after the user has explicitly agreed to send these exact details to Barmaan.

locale.description: Content language: en, fa, ar or ckb.

message.description: What the customer needs: product, quantity, specs, destination.

name.description: Customer full name, asked from the user (never guessed).

phone.description: Customer phone/WhatsApp with country code, asked from the user.

product_code.description: 6-digit product code or product slug, if the request is about one product.

name: request_quote
title: Request a quote
